three_dimensional_model_status: No existing generic 0805/C24 STEP model dimensions were used as evidence. A generic model must not be treated as enclosure or stacked-child-board height proof.
assembly_acceptance_notes: Both under-body via annuli remain outside every B.Paste polygon and B.Mask pad opening. Board-default back tenting specifies no via-specific B.Mask opening.
Via 097c5d92 front side coincides with the J4.6 pad mask opening despite its inherited via tenting setting; the bottom capacitor side remains specified tented.

This is an unfilled, unplugged 0.200 mm drill construction; source mask intent is not a guarantee of complete physical tent coverage. Fabrication/assembly must confirm reliable bottom tenting, no solder wicking/balls or uneven standoff under C27, and suitable mask support between lands.

If the fabricator cannot qualify this construction, relocate the two under-body vias or obtain an explicitly approved fabrication treatment and recheck geometry; do not silently add a filled/capped process.
Verify at least 1.45 mm part-height envelope plus assembly/standoff tolerance against the actual enclosure and any stacked child board. No Z-clearance evidence is available in this study.
